A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 40-page MetricAnything paper, including supplementary analyses, training details, equations and references. Text and rendered pages match except for the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark results for MetricAnything and its students in Section 4, ablations in Section 5 and real-world robustness evaluations in Section 6.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark results, ablations and robustness evaluations unchanged in Sections 4–6.

M1.justification: Sparse Metric Prompt preparation and injection, pretraining, student distillation, architectures and losses are identical in Sections 3 and 7.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same approximately 20M training pairs and retain identical depth, camera-calibration, reconstruction, LIBERO, VSI-Bench and unseen-domain evaluations.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding experiment. For example, Table 1 includes LingBot-Depth, PromptDA and PriorDA in both versions with identical comparison rows.

E3.justification: Evaluation and training settings match throughout Sections 4–7, including prompt types, metrics, resolutions, training budgets, zero-shot splits and the ScanNet split exception.

E4.justification: Section 5 retains identical scaling, architecture, resolution, loss, prompt-density and balance-weight analyses. Section 6 retains the same sensor, weather and unseen-domain robustness evidence.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version supplies experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, rankings and qualitative results match. For example, the reported LIBERO average remains 87.7 in Table 10 and the VSI-Bench average remains 58.3 in Table 11.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions, camera assumptions, focal-length optimization and loss formulations are identical, including Equations 1–15 and the supplementary metric definitions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about scalable metric-depth pretraining, learning from heterogeneous sources and downstream generalization.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and result interpretations are unchanged. Section 8 retains the same limitations concerning central-projection cameras and unexplored architectural scaling.

D1.justification: Section 7 retains identical hardware, initialization, learning rates, training schedules, preprocessing and loss weights. The project access link is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, research-positioning statements and the complete reference list are identical; no cited works or novelty relationships are added or removed.

P1.justification: Only the first-page margin stamp changes from arXiv v1 dated 29 January 2026 to v2 dated 3 July 2026. Manuscript wording, headings and section order are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–23 and Tables 1–15 retain identical content, captions, formatting and placement. The updated margin stamp leaves the manuscript layout unchanged.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, supporting evidence, reproducibility details and presentation are identical across both complete PDFs. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp provides no meaningful change in overall paper quality.
